Adds a line at the bottom of every Claude Code terminal: which account it is on, how much of the 5-hour and 7-day windows is left, the model and the directory.
Terminals opened per account show their own account, not the default login.
Written into ~/.claude/settings.json; unchecking removes it.

settings.warmup.cloud.tip:
Creates daily Claude Code routines on each account (claude.ai/code/routines) that send one tiny Haiku request at {0} and after each reset, so the clock starts even with this PC off.
Each run counts toward the account's daily routine runs (Pro 5, Max 15). Setting up takes one short Claude session per account.
Unchecking pauses them; delete them on the web if you no longer want them.

settings.warmup.tip:
Claude's 5-hour limit starts counting at your first message and resets 5 hours later.
When on, this app sends one tiny Haiku request at {0} to start that clock early, so resets land inside your work hours.
After each reset it starts the next round automatically until {1}:00; multiple accounts are staggered.
The app must be running.

wizard.step1.body:
Claude Switch puts multi-account logins, usage and auto-switching in one place.

· Every card shows the 5-hour and 7-day usage
· One-click switching, and automatic switching near a rate limit
· Lives in the tray — closing the window does not quit (Shift+Close does)
wizard.step1.title: Switching Claude accounts, with less to keep in your head
wizard.step2.body:
1. Sign in to an account with Claude Code on this machine
2. Come back here and choose “Add account” to manage it
3. Select an account and choose the green Switch button, or double-click the card; auto-switch is optional

Tips: drag a card to reorder the list; tray notifications mask the middle of an email address.
wizard.step2.title: Three steps to get going
wizard.step3.body:
Make sure Claude Code is signed in, then choose “Add account” at the bottom right.

To look around first, choose “Skip”, or launch with --fixture to open sample data.
wizard.step3.title: Capture this machine's current login
wizard.title: Welcome to Claude Switch
